result.explanation: The direct rule is recursive three-way merge: equal edits win; otherwise an unchanged side yields the other side; object/object disagreements recurse; all other disagreements retain base and record the path. A tempting alternative is last-writer-wins, but it fails when both sides independently change a scalar differently.
result.mapping: At each path, base/local/remote values map directly to the merge decision and conflict path.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated legal JSON and depth limits. State is unused because events are independent.
